thread:
maria: Quick one — UX review for the new latency chart. Noticed tooltips show raw microseconds, which reads ugly. Can we show humanized units and include source label?
aj: yep, raw µs is noisy. think we should convert to ms/s depending on magnitude, with soft switch. e.g., 230000 -> 230ms, 0.00023 -> 230µs. keep the exact value in a smaller sub-line.
samir: Agreed. Also propose a keyboard affordance: focus legend items with arrow keys and hit Enter to toggle series visibility. Accessibility folks want a visible focus ring and an aria-live region for legend changes.
eva: On the tooltip copy: currently 'p50: 230000' — change to 'p50 latency — 230 ms (raw: 230000 µs)'. Put unit first? not necessary, but make it consistent across charts.
maria: Good. Another note: when smoothing is on, tooltip should indicate smoothing window (e.g., 'smoothed • window=5m'). Otherwise folks misinterpret.
tim: small nit: decimal rounding. For ms show 1 decimal for <100ms, whole ms for >100ms. For seconds show 2 decimals up to 60s, then humanize.
aj: Implementation detail: we can reuse the existing formatters in utils/formatters.ts. sample snippet: ```js
function formatLatency(n){
  if(n>1000000) return (n/1e6).toFixed(2)+" s";
  if(n>1000) return (n/1000).toFixed(1)+" ms";
  return n+" µs";
}
```
design-bot: Reminder — update QA checklist: keyboard legend toggle, tooltip unit display, smoothing badge.
samir: Chart layout question: when legend is collapsed into the header, keyboard focus needs to move to a combobox-style control. current collapsed state loses context. prefer keeping legend visible for small-multiples grid < 3 cols.
eva: For small multiples, can we add 'legend per row' option? that reduces visual scanning. also think about reducing dot size when series count > 6.
maria: Also outlier handling — the current clamp shows spikes as flat line. request to add an explicit 'outlier clipped' marker on the axis (a chevron icon) with tooltip: "values > 1s clipped". visual affordance helps debugging.
tim: +1. And make that marker keyboard focusable with aria-label: "Outliers clipped on upper bound".
aj: One more: when copying numbers from tooltip (clipboard action), copy raw value by default but display formatted value. Add a little copy icon.
eva: Accessibility QA: ensure screen readers read both formatted and raw values, but raw can be hidden visually (aria-hidden false/true toggles).
samir: I'm happy with the scope. Next steps: AJ to mock small tooltip sample and keyboard flow, Maria to write copy variations for the tooltip lines, Eva to draft a11y acceptance criteria. Can we have short walkthrough by EOW? :calendar: 
aj: I'll put a prototype in Figma and push a tiny PR with formatters. target EOW. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll drop copy options into the doc and include examples for p95/p99.
eva: I'll write the a11y checklist and include NVDA/VoiceOver quick steps.
design-bot: Action items created: #UX-342 tooltip unit + keyboard legend, #A11Y-78 legend focus & outlier marker.
maria: thanks everyone — posting this to the design board after AJ's mock. :sparkles:
